from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0054.png"))
# In obs_0054, the grey armchair is clearly visible in full!
# Let us check the coordinates of its base contacts on the floor:
mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 70) & (img[:, :, 0] < 140) & \
       (img[:, :, 1] > 80) & (img[:, :, 1] < 140) & \
       (img[:, :, 2] > 90) & (img[:, :, 2] < 155)

ys, xs = np.where(mask)
print(f"Armchair in 54: xs=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], ys=[{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}]")
print(f"Bottom contact row: {ys.max()}, x at bottom: {xs[ys == ys.max()]}")

# Front corner / base corners:
# Let us find bottom points along the base
cols = np.unique(xs[ys > ys.max() - 20])
print(f"Lowest points: ys around {ys.max()}: columns {cols.min()} to {cols.max()}")
'
